$comment: Hand-curated, sourced inputs. Edit here, then run `npm run build:data`. Every value needs low <= mid <= high, a unit, and at least one source with a URL and retrieved date. Ranges are evaluated level-by-level: all lows together, all mids together, all highs together.

sources.label: Google: "the median Gemini Apps text prompt uses 0.24 watt-hours (Wh) of energy" (Aug 2025; includes idle machines and data-centre overhead)
OpenAI (Sam Altman): "the average query uses about 0.34 watt-hours" (June 2025)
MIT Technology Review: Llama 3.1 405B, "an estimated 6,706 joules total, for each response"
sources.note: Article estimates totals by doubling measured GPU energy.

sources.label: MIT Technology Review: Stable Diffusion 3 Medium 1024px, "an estimated 2,282 joules total" (low); "about 4,402 joules" at higher quality (mid)
sources.note: Article estimates totals by doubling measured GPU energy.

sources.label: Luccioni, Jernite, Strubell, Power Hungry Processing (2023): "image generation, whose mean consumption is 2.9kWh" per 1,000 inferences

videoClipWh.label: Electricity per short AI video (about 5 seconds)

sources.label: MIT Technology Review: older CogVideoX clip "about 109,000 joules" (low); newer five-second clip "about 3.4 million joules" (mid). No published figure for frontier video models, so high = mid.
sources.note: Article estimates totals by doubling measured GPU energy.

onsiteWaterLPerKWh.label: Water used at the AI building (cooling) per kWh

sources.label: Amazon: "global data center operations used just 0.12 liters of water per kilowatt-hour (L/kWh) in 2025"
Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, 2024 US Data Center Energy Usage Report (p. 48): "the overall average WUE, which stays just over 0.36 L/kWh through 2023"
Google: the median text prompt "consumes 0.26 milliliters ... of water" for 0.24 Wh (= 1.08 L/kWh, our division)

offsiteWaterLPerKWh.label: Water used at power plants to make each kWh

sources.label: Mytton, Data centre water consumption (npj Clean Water 2021): "The US average water intensity for electricity generation for 2015 was 2.18 litres per kilowatt hour" (mid); generation cooling "consumption ranging from 0.00 to 4.4 L/kWh ... depending on the system characteristics" (low, high)
Google: the median text prompt "emits 0.03 grams of carbon dioxide equivalent" for 0.24 Wh, using Google's 2024 fleetwide grid carbon intensity (= 125 g/kWh, our division)
Ember Global Electricity Review 2025: "Emissions intensity dropped by 2.3% to 473 grams of CO2 per kilowatt hour (gCO2/kWh)" in 2024

dataCentreTWhPerYear.label: Electricity used by all data centres worldwide per year

sources.label: IEA Energy and AI (2025): "electricity consumption from data centres is estimated to amount to around 415 terawatt hours (TWh), or about 1.5% of global electricity consumption in 2024"
United Nations, World Population Prospects 2024 press release (11 July 2024): "8.2 billion people in 2024"

quiz.$comment: Bucket index -> usage. From the design plan (OV #4: 3-tap quiz).

comparisons.$comment: Illustrative household sizes used only to turn numbers into things a kid can picture. Shown as approximate.
